statement: Linux v6.12 hid-wiimote binds Bluetooth HID 0306 and 0330, maps recognized old name first to Gen 1 and TR name to Gen 2, then falls back to Nintendo VID/PID; Gen 2 modules set WIIPROTO_FLAG_BUILTIN_MP and suppress periodic MP hotplug polling while Gen 1 lacks that builtin flag. This is kernel classification/behavior only, not a measured physical early Plus startup or proof that 0330 identity alone works.

applicability.revision: Original RVL-003, early integrated RVL-036 non-TR, later RVL-036 TR; no physical revision measured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. Linux v6.12 core.c 570-605,811-927,1867-1877; modules.c 2630-2667; header flags 27-45. No host run. All proposed physical or host tests are not run.
